none: PAS LEIC-FDF316: 6 Roman silver denarii Fused
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Six Roman silver denarii fused together and badly damaged in places. The coins are positioned so that they overlap slightly with one near the centre protruding slightly further out. An obverse is visible on each outer coin and have been identified as follows. Denarius of Hadrian [..] IAN[HA]DRIANVSAVG 117-138. Denarius of Trajan (prob ), no inscription showing, badly. damaged on right hand side. Reverse shows N?VN 98-117. The central coin shows the partial inscription [..] HADRIAN[VS]. Reverse type standing female with cornucopia, partial inscription COS. As these are the only datable components they provide a probable date range of 98-138
